name: texture_sweep_scramble
title: Sweep-filter a texture bed, blur it, granulate, re-cut
material: broadband textures - field recordings, room tone, noise beds
description: Animates static texture: a slow sweeping filter drags a resonant peak across the bed, blur blur fuses what remains, brassage half-speeds it granularly, and extend scramble re-cuts the result into a new 4-second sequence of chunks (seeded, so the chunk order is reproducible).
source: Verified end-to-end on a drifting filtered-noise field proxy in the Phase 5 generalization matrix (tests/test_generalization.py, field chain; docs/generalization-matrix.md).
notes: sweepfrq is sweeps per second - 0.167 is one full up-down cycle over ~6 s; scale it to your input duration.
the seed param pins extend scramble's otherwise clock-seeded chunk order - same seed, same sequence.
scramble treats outdur as a floor: output overruns by up to about one maxseglen chunk (curated finding).
